newsitem.title: USA: Hein-Werner votes 5 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Hein-Werner votes 5 pct stock dividend.

text.p: Hein-Werner Corp said Thursday it had declared a five percent stock dividend and expected higher 1996 earnings.
The dividend is payable January 24, record January 3.

President and Chief Executive Officer Joseph Dindorf said in a statement, "Hein-Werner's 1996 earnings are projected to be up sharply, as buyers make their purchasing decisions at major equipment product trade shows during the fourth quarter.
"These improved results will be directly attributable to the sustained improvement in our core businesses, collision repair and fluid power."
For 1995 Hein-Werner reported earnings of $0.39 per share.
In the stock dividend, fractional shares will be paid in cash, based on the closing stock price on the American Stock Exchange on January 3, it said.
Mary Kielich, corporate controller, told Reuters that even though the company sees higher earnings, it was not making a specific forecast.
Hein-Werner manufactures collision repair, engine rebuilding and fluid power equipment.
